title: INTERSECT returns the rows of the left table found in the right, with the duplicates of the left

source.quote: If a row appears in tableExpression1 and tableExpression2, it and all duplicates in tableExpression1 are included in the result set.
source.supports: the page shows these two tables (States1, States2) and this result

derivation: Left: A, A, B, B, B, C, D, D. Right holds B, C, D (and E). The left rows B (3 times), C, D (twice) are kept; D is in the right table three times but that does not add rows.
